note: LUMIERE same-week pairs on the atlas route (card steps 2 and 4 to 7). The frame, intensity and registration blocks come unchanged from configs/experiments/EXP-2026-001.json, which is read, never edited. Values approved by the researcher on 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-21.

provenance.pre_label: public automated: DeepBraTumIA atlas mask, renumbered to RHUH IDs; not reviewed by an expert
provenance.post_label: public automated: DeepBraTumIA atlas mask, unverified; used only as a region left out of registration and QC, never as a target

foreground: voxels differing from the border background of DeepBraTumIA's atlas copy, i.e. DeepBraTumIA's own skull stripping (chosen 2026-11-21: on the 4 sample pairs its brain volume changed by at most 3% from pre-op to post-op, against up to 9% for the released HD-BET masks)

timing.note: post-op scan in the same week as the pre-op scan; early post-op (<72 h) by the centre's protocol; day not verified

licence: LUMIERE v202211: non-commercial use (dataset paper and readme); CC0 (Figshare record). The stricter terms are followed.

mask_check.hdglio_reading: HD-GLIO-AUTO native masks are read as stored or flipped along two axes, whichever puts their brightest label on enhancing T1ce in most pre-op studies (added 2026-11-21: all 8 sample studies were stored flipped along index axes 0 and 2)

split.strata: expert rating: complete or partial resection
split.pinned_to_train: the 4 pairs chosen by rhuh_synthesis.lumiere_pairs.choose_sample(eligible pairs, seed=2026), used for local development

acceptance.applied: automatically in both roles; a flagged pair is quarantined and kept in the denominator; no case is rescued by looking at it
